description: VisioForge Video Capture SDK .NET captures, records and streams video and audio from webcams, IP cameras (RTSP, ONVIF), screens, NDI and SRT sources, Blackmagic Decklink cards and GenICam industrial cameras. The cross-platform VideoCaptureCoreX engine, built on GStreamer, runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS; the Windows-only DirectShow engine, VideoCaptureCore, also supports TV tuners and DV/HDV camcorders. Records to MP4, MKV, WebM, AVI, MOV, MPEG-TS, WMV and more with GPU-accelerated H264/HEVC encoding (NVIDIA, Intel, AMD, Apple), and streams over RTMP (YouTube, Facebook Live), SRT, HLS, NDI and a built-in RTSP server. Targets .NET Framework 4.6.1+, .NET Core 3.1 and .NET 5 to .NET 11; WinForms and WPF video views are built in, WinUI, MAUI, Avalonia and Uno views come in the VisioForge.DotNet.Core.UI.* packages. Samples - https://github.com/visioforge/.Net-SDK-s-samples .
releaseNotes: Bug fixes and performance improvements. Please check changelog.
